MY LITTLE PET · LITTLEPET.IN

Privacy policy

Effective date: 23 October 2026. This policy covers littlepet.in and official My Little Pet applications, provided by Teja Priyan, India. Contact: teja1616150@gmail.com.

Information on this website

The showcase does not offer checkout, user accounts, advertising trackers or an email-signup form. The name demonstration runs in your browser; names entered there are not submitted to our server or placed in a link. They are cleared when you reload the page.

Our hosting provider may process your IP address, browser information, requested URL and access time to deliver and secure the website. Operational log retention depends on the hosting provider’s configuration. We have not added visitor analytics or advertising cookies.

Game names, progress and backups

The Windows game saves pet names, owner nicknames, progress and settings locally. The upcoming mobile web app stores saves in browser/device storage and caches game files for offline use. Use a nickname rather than sensitive personal information. There is no automatic Windows-to-phone synchronization.

Backups you export are files on your device. Clearing browser storage can delete mobile progress. Uninstalling the Windows application may leave its save folder behind; remove that folder yourself if you want to delete your local save. Keep a backup first if you want to retain progress.

Support messages

If you email us, we receive your email address, message and attachments. We use them to answer you, investigate problems and maintain necessary support records. Email is processed by our email provider. We retain correspondence only as needed for these purposes or applicable recordkeeping obligations. You can request deletion by email, subject to those obligations.

Downloads and third parties

Free download links take you to itch.io, which processes data under its own privacy policy. External links are not loaded as embedded checkout or tracking widgets on this site. We do not sell personal information.

Payments

There is no payment collection on this website. We do not request card, UPI or bank information. Before paid Plus launches, this policy will be updated to explain the approved provider, order information and relevant retention practices.

Children and privacy choices

We do not ask children to provide personal details through the showcase. Parents or guardians can contact us about information sent to support. You can manage local game data on your device and contact us about information we hold through email.

Security and changes

Keep backups and private access codes secure. No storage or transmission system can guarantee absolute security. Material changes to this policy will be reflected here with an updated effective date.
